info.title: Kotoha Filter Language Bridge
info.description:
kotoha-filter-lsp: a bridge for editors that start a language server as a process. It
            relays the language server protocol between standard input and output and the Kotoha
            plugin's filter language WebSocket, with no language logic of its own.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: kotoha-filter-lsp: relays the Kotoha filter language server to standard input and output.

options.name: --url
options.description:
ws(s):// URL of the endpoint, or Shoko's http(s):// base URL
(default: $KOTOHA_FILTER_LSP_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8111)

options.name: --api-key-file
options.description: a file holding the API key (default: $KOTOHA_API_KEY)

options.name: --help
options.description:
this text
